description:
Activate Marneus by paying {6}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Marneus' ability.
Resolve the copy of Marneus' ability, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Marneus, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the original Marneus ability from step 1, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Marneus, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing four Astartes Warriors, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
